summary: Evaluate the consequences of a planner's own actions rather than only how closely it imitates recorded trajectories.
outcomes: Distinguish open-loop prediction metrics from closed-loop planning outcomes
Define scenario coverage, operating domain and interaction-model limitations
sequence: Specify route, actors and operating conditions
Score a planner against a recorded trajectory
Run the same planner in a closed-loop simulator
Vary reactive actors, sensor faults and rare scenarios
Report collisions, progress, comfort and unresolved simulation gaps

visual.question: Can a planner match logged motion yet fail when its own actions change the scene?
visual.interaction: Perturb the ego trajectory and compare replayed versus reactive surrounding actors

practice.task: Create a simulation-only navigation evaluation report
practice.success: Metrics, scenario selection, failure traces and simulator assumptions bound the reported claim
